subject: VertexPay: sudden latency & 5xx spike after model swap — immediate help requested
messages:
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@vertexpay.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Carolyn Ng <cng@vertexpay.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:12:00Z
Subject: [VertexPay] latency + 5xx spike after last night's model swap

Connor / Marissa —

We rolled the model swap you coordinated last night (v5.1 with quant profile qcompact-2) across prod in us-east-1 at ~02:30 local. Since ~06:40 UTC we've seen an abrupt regression: p95 token latency jumped from our baseline ~120ms to ~520ms and 5xx error rate climbed to ~1.8% (was <0.05% before). Throughput per node has dropped ~22% and tail latency is killing our checkout flow.

Attached are truncated request logs and a few example traces (vertex_logs_20260802.zip) and a screenshot of the checkout error stream. This is impacting our conversion funnel — we have a marketing campaign launching tomorrow and need this fixed with high priority.

Please confirm receipt, immediate next steps, and whether you can roll us back to the previous model/quant quickly. If needed we'll open a maintenance window.

Thanks —
Alex Wu
Sr. Platform Engineer, VertexPay

---
From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@vertexpay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-02T09:26:00Z
Subject: Re: [VertexPay] latency + 5xx spike after last night's model swap

Alex — thanks for the heads up and for the logs. We see the same signals in our telemetry for your account. Immediate acknowledgements and plan below: 

1) Triage: I've kicked off a diagnostics bridge. Rishi + Mina are joining to look at kernel/runtime paths and quant switching effects.
2) Mitigation ask: can we run an immediate canary rollback to the previous model pack v5.0 + qfp1 quant for 10% of traffic? That should confirm whether the quant profile change correlates to the latency/5xx spike. If you approve, we'll schedule the rollback within 20 minutes.
3) Data needed: please forward one or two trace IDs (span ids) from 06:40-07:00 UTC and whether you saw the issue in both synchronous and async endpoints. Also: did you change any request parameters (max_tokens/beam settings) during the deploy?
4) Exec loop: Marissa, I'd like a short exec note with recommended customer communication and any commercial remediation (credits) since this hits their launch.

We attached a short rollback_playbook_v1.md to this thread for transparency. We'll keep the bridge tight and post back with the result.

—Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

---
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-02T09:35:00Z
Subject: Re: [VertexPay] latency + 5xx spike after last night's model swap

Looping in for customer-facing coordination and commercial posture. Short summary for execs: VertexPay observed a production regression after a scheduled model + quant change (v5.1 / qcompact-2). The issue is high-severity — impacts checkout conversion and an imminent marketing launch.

Suggested immediate actions: 
- Approve canary rollback to v5.0 + qfp1 for 10% traffic now; if green, extend rollback to 100% over 15 minutes.
- Offer a service credit of 15% for this week of usage and commit to a joint postmortem within 72 hours.
- Prepare a short public-facing status note we can share with VertexPay contacts (1-2 bullets: what happened, what we're doing, ETA to resolution).

I'll draft the customer note once Rishi confirms root-cause direction. Connor — if rollback is safe operationally, please proceed and loop me in on timelines so I can sync CS/AM.

Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

---
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-02T09:47:00Z
Subject: Re: [VertexPay] latency + 5xx spike after last night's model swap

Initial technical findings from a quick pass on the traces:
- The error spikes are predominantly 502/504 from our runtime rather than application-layer exceptions; stack traces show timeouts in the attention-fused kernel path when serving qcompact-2 on A100 inference nodes.
- The new quant profile triggers a different kernel selection in the runtime; on sequences >256 tokens the kernel falls into a non-vectorized fallback path in our current deploy (we missed a kernel guard for qcompact-2). That explains both increased latency and throughput drop.
- We'll attempt two mitigation steps in parallel: (A) hotfix the kernel-selection guard and push a quick patch (30-45m estimated), (B) immediate rollback to earlier quant/profile (v5.0 + qfp1) as a faster mitigation.

Operational notes: rollback to v5.0+qfp1 is reversible and low-risk for VertexPay. We should throttle canary rollback to 10% then 30% then 100% with 5 minute observation windows. If you authorize, Connor, ops can start the canary rollback now.

I'll also capture a short blameless root-cause note for the postmortem.

Rishi Malhotra
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime — Redwood Inference

---
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@vertexpay.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-02T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: [VertexPay] latency + 5xx spike after last night's model swap

Thanks — that plan sounds good. Please proceed with the canary rollback to v5.0 + qfp1 (10%→30%→100%) and keep us updated in the bridge. We'll freeze any further traffic changes on our side.

For the traces: see span IDs included in the attached logs (vertex_logs_20260802.zip). Confirm when the first 10% rollback is live and we will run a quick smoke test on checkout flows.

Appreciate the quick response. Please include a postmortem link in the follow-up and a short ETA for the kernel-selection patch — if the rollback stabilizes us, we'll still need the patch to safely adopt qcompact-2 later.

—Alex
Sr. Platform Engineer, VertexPay

Attachments referenced: screenshot-error-500.png (sample request failures), vertex_logs_20260802.zip (traces), rollback_playbook_v1.md (Redwood internal runbook).
